environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (10.0.128.0/20, 10.0.144.0/20) with no NAT gateway egress path configured for inbound origination. Service is fronted by an internal NLB registered as a VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). Consumer access is restricted via endpoint policy allowing only principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root. The NLB has no public DNS, no internet gateway route exists in the private subnet route tables, and the Fargate task security group (sg-0xdeadbeef) allows inbound TCP/8080 only from the VPC endpoint ENI security group (sg-0xfeedface). There is no other ingress path. The VPC has no peering connections, no Transit Gateway attachments, and Flow Logs confirm zero packets from non-RFC1918 sources reaching the ENIs.

config.network_exposure: AWS PrivateLink VPC Endpoint Service only
config.subnet_route_tables: no igw route, no nat gateway
config.security_group_ingress: TCP/8080 from sg-0xfeedface (VPC endpoint ENIs) only
config.vpc_connectivity: no peering, no TGW, no VPN, no Direct Connect
